scenario: LOPQ.3.1 / 5.2 — equality is always available on an opaque value and is the routing primitive: an opaque-typed slot may be equality-joined across patterns against a value of the same opaque type. Compiles clean.
rules_ds:
opaque type Key over Bytes

schema Machine scope logical:
    pubkey: Key key

schema Trusted scope logical:
    pubkey: Key key

rule r:
    Machine m
    Trusted t where t.pubkey == m.pubkey
->
    log info "match"
